verdict.rationale: Groq's docs (console.groq.com/docs) contain many runnable code snippets (Python/JS/curl) for chat, streaming, tool-use, structured outputs, MCP, etc., which supports experimentation, but there is no evidence of a true interactive API reference (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI playground) — a probe explicitly found no openapi.json/swagger.json at any candidate path, and no mention of an interactive 'try it' console exists in the evidence. missing for 10: an interactive OpenAPI/Swagger-style explorer, in-browser 'run this request' playground, independent confirmation of interactivity.
